entries.title: Brazil coffee survey: higher inventories, advancing traceability and AI adoption
key_points: Six exporters held 1.97m bags at end-May 2026, 25.5% more than a year earlier; large producers' stocks up 49%.
Surveyed producers had sold about 56% of their 2026/27 crop by May, leaving a lot to sell through the season.
Record 2026/27 Brazil crop; 2027/28 expected harder on the biennial cycle.

entries.title: Brazilian coffee monthly update: September 2026
key_points: Brazil shipped 4.15m bags in August (+31% y/y); January–July was 2.2% below 2025.
Arabica fell about 15% in September while robusta was flat, so the arb narrowed.

September rain well above normal in South Minas, Matas de Minas and Espírito Santo helps flowering; the market story is turning to surplus and stock rebuilding, though weather and logistics still matter.
